audit_scope: scGPT-whole-human CELLxGENE Census pretraining overlap audit across CRLM datasets

dataset_assessments.rationale: Initial GEO submission (2023-10-17) and public release (2024-01-05) occurred >5 and ~8 months after the 2023-05-08 CELLxGENE Census snapshot.
dataset_assessments.interpretive_rule: Development OOF scGPT vs PCA comparisons have zero pretraining data overlap.

dataset_assessments.rationale: Public ~15 months before 2023-05-08. If ingested into CELLxGENE Census by 2023-05-08, adjacent normal colon (intestine), normal liver (others), and PBMC (blood) cells match disease == 'normal' in whole-human; tumor cells match colorectal cancer in pan-cancer queries. Exact SOMA dataset_id roster is not bundled with best_model.pt.
dataset_assessments.interpretive_rule: Primary biological confirmation relies on non-scGPT gene-program statistics; M6 scGPT classifiers must be reported alongside zero-pretraining PCA baselines on identical donor bags without claiming blind zero-exposure foundation generalization.

dataset_assessments.rationale: Public ~20 months before 2023-05-08. If ingested into CELLxGENE Census by 2023-05-08, PBMC (blood) or normal-annotated cells match disease == 'normal' in whole-human; tumor cells match colorectal cancer in pan-cancer queries. Exact SOMA dataset_id roster is not bundled with best_model.pt.
dataset_assessments.interpretive_rule: Primary biological confirmation relies on non-scGPT gene-program statistics; M6 GSE178318 scGPT classifiers (encoded post-freeze on 12 PT/LM tumor libraries with 3 PBMC libraries physically excluded) must be reported alongside zero-pretraining PCA baselines on identical donor bags without claiming zero-pretraining foundation generalization.

dataset_assessments.rationale: Remained embargoed/non-public on GEO until 2023-10-20 (5.4 months after 2023-05-08 Census snapshot) and is not used for scGPT model inference.
dataset_assessments.interpretive_rule: Evaluated with gene-program statistics only; unaffected by scGPT representation pretraining.

dataset_assessments.rationale: Excluded from V1/V1.1 paired inference pending donor-ID resolution.
Public >2 years after 2023-05-08 snapshot and not encoded with scGPT.
Public >3 years after 2023-05-08 snapshot; 377-gene 10x Xenium spatial imaging cohort not encoded with scGPT.
